vaniglia-research-figure-1-panel-c.licenseBasis: The publication copyright section licenses the article CC BY and links CC BY 4.0. Figure 1 has no separate third-party credit or license exception. Preserve author credit, publication citation, license link, and viewport disclosure.
vaniglia-research-figure-1-panel-c.identityBasis: The primary study explicitly identifies panel C as Vaniglia; its fruit material section documents orchard-grown, harvested specimens. Nursery name references connect Vaniglia to English Vanilla persimmon.
vaniglia-research-figure-1-panel-c.pixelReview: Inspected the decoded original. Panel C is bottom-left: whole orange round to slightly flattened fruits, green calyx, two cut views with brown-orange seeded interiors, and loose seeds on a neutral background. Other panels depict other cultivars and must never enter this lesson's recognition frame.

proposedSourceViewport.basis: Interior of bottom-left panel C, excluding other cultivar panels and the lower scale bar. Browser review at mobile and desktop lesson sizes confirms only the cultivar panel is shown; a small edge of its C label may remain. No raster alteration has been performed.

vaniglia-research-figure-1-panel-c.requiredPresentation: Use only a fixed reviewed panel-C source viewport. Do not display the full four-cultivar figure, claim independent observations from one composite, or infer store origin, package quantity, flavor, or checkout code from this image.
vaniglia-research-figure-1-panel-c.roleReuseBasis: One published photographic panel is available. Reusing its viewport across hero, alternate, and context roles remains a one-source fallback, not three independent photographs.
